svg.text: The driver plans, delegates, watches and reviews. Every other identity runs as a background job, and every step leaves a file behind.
the driver attacks it, deep_reasoner reads it
the whole diff, against the brief
cancel; resubmit or take it back
One background job per row, one jobId
state comes from files: pid, exit_code, cancelled
the plan every gate judges against
written by the driver, by hand
